sources.snippet: The base models, instruct models, and reward model of the Qwen2.5-Math series are available on Hugging Face 1 and ModelScope2, and the evaluation scripts on GitHub3. We have also developed a demo that supports the TIR mode in Qwen-Agent4, which allows running code locally to experience Tool-Integrated Reasoning capabilities of Qwen2.5-Math.
